designDetails.silhouette: Inherit the V66 1979 Big Chap: extremely long smooth dome, very tall slender biped, narrow waist, long arms and legs, four readable dorsal tubes and one full segmented spear-tail.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl-ivory and pale gray-beige biomechanical tissue, translucent rose-taupe structures beneath the dome, cool gray recesses, restrained moist highlights and silver/ivory teeth.
designDetails.surface: Pale organic-biomechanical ribs, tubing and wet carapace relief remain legible through value and subsurface contrast. The albino result is newly authored material, never a filtered white copy.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless smooth domed head with double jaw, one ribbed torso, two long arms, two digitigrade legs, four dorsal tubes and exactly one continuous articulated tail. No equipment.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses; dome, jaws, hands, feet, dorsal tubes and complete tail remain inside each cell without camera rotation.
designDetails.scale: Inherit the reviewed V66 enemy-004 physical scale and rigid cranial/thoracic proportions. Never scale from the changing tail arc or crouch height.
designDetails.root: Inherit the base reviewed pelvis/proximal-leg physical registration and supporting-foot floor. Dorsal tubes, dome and tail must never redefine the root.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, scene, hive resin, text or grid.
